ios.desc:
Mame Sama: The Trusted Vegan Japan Guide

Mame Sama was created by vegans living in Japan to make vegan life a little easier.
It is a growing guide to everything vegan in Japan! Search for and list anything helpful to living a plant-based life. Find vegan food and restaurants, shopping, community groups, events, sanctuaries, and more.

Support vegan-friendly businesses and stay informed about animal rights events from Tokyo to Osaka. Whether you are traveling through Japan or building your life here, Mame Sama helps you discover places you can actually trust.

Mame Sama is more than just ratings and reviews. It is a trove of information verified by the vegan community. Listings go up instantly, and reported content is taken seriously.

• 100% Vegan Focus: No guesswork or hidden ingredients.
• Transparent and Community-Driven: Real info from locals.
• Updated Events and Meetups: Connect with the community.
• Support Animal Rights: Learn about local campaigns.
• Bilingual Support: Full English and Japanese options.

There are no paid listings or hidden priorities. Our only motive is to create a more vegan world. Whether you are new to veganism or just want better vegan food options, Mame Sama is your ultimate companion for navigating Japan.

quotes.text:
Mame Sama - A free Android/iOS app for finding vegan resources (primarily within, but not limited to, Japan). Essentially it's Instagram with a location requirement. While not-yet-open-source, that is the plan. I wanted to build something without any intention to monetize it, while relying on the community to contribute to its success and maintenance.

Backend is zig, frontend is in Flutter. First foray into zig and I'm really enjoying it.

- https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mame-sama-%E3%81%BE%E3%82%81%E3%81%95%E3%81%BE/id6746381767

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mamesama&hl=en
